spec.description: Group pool funding (实缴池 = pendingbot.group_pools.total_remaining_pnc_micros, with fairness share_index), member contributions (pendingbot.group_contributions, active rows) and pledges (认缴 = pendingbot.group_pledges.pledge_pnc_micros, active). All amounts PNC = *_pnc_micros / 1e6. The pool balance mirrors Polar (Polar is the balance source of truth). NOTE: group_pools/group_contributions/group_pledges have RLS scoped to group members; the metabase_ro BI role needs a permissive read policy (see supabase migration 20260603094114_metabase_ro_group_billing_read.sql) or these panels return no rows.

panels.description: 实缴池: total remaining PNC across all group pools (group_pools.total_remaining_pnc_micros). Mirrors Polar.
panels.title: Group pool remaining balance (实缴池, PNC)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_remaining_pnc_micros), 0) / 1e6 AS group_pool_remaining_pnc
FROM pendingbot.group_pools;

panels.description: 认缴: sum of active member pledges across all groups (group_pledges.pledge_pnc_micros WHERE status = 'active'). Pledge = the spend cap a member authorises; the money stays in their personal wallet.
panels.title: Active pledges (认缴, PNC)

panels.description: Active member contributions (实缴): total contributed PNC across all groups (group_contributions WHERE status = 'active'). The funded backing behind the pool balance.
panels.title: Active contributions (实缴, PNC)

panels.description: Per-group pool: remaining balance + share_index (fairness factor), active contribution count/total, active pledge count/total. Largest pools first. Amounts in PNC.
panels.title: Per-group pool usage

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  gp.subject_id,
  s.display_name AS group_name,
  gp.total_remaining_pnc_micros / 1e6 AS remaining_pnc,
  gp.share_index,
  COALESCE(con.active_contributors, 0) AS active_contributors,
  COALESCE(con.contributed_pnc, 0) AS contributed_pnc,
  COALESCE(pl.active_pledgers, 0) AS active_pledgers,
  COALESCE(pl.pledged_pnc, 0) AS pledged_pnc,
  gp.updated_at
FROM pendingbot.group_pools gp
LEFT JOIN pendingbot.subjects s ON s.id = gp.subject_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT subject_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT contributor_user_id) AS active_contributors,
    SUM(contributed_pnc_micros) / 1e6 AS contributed_pnc
  FROM pendingbot.group_contributions
  WHERE status = 'active'
  GROUP BY subject_id
) con ON con.subject_id = gp.subject_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT subject_id,
    COUNT(*) AS active_pledgers,
    SUM(pledge_pnc_micros) / 1e6 AS pledged_pnc
  FROM pendingbot.group_pledges
  WHERE status = 'active'
  GROUP BY subject_id
) pl ON pl.subject_id = gp.subject_id
ORDER BY gp.total_remaining_pnc_micros DESC
LIMIT 200;

spec.title: PendingBot — Group Pool & Pledge
